verdict.rationale: A live probe found a downloadable OpenAPI document at vercel.com/openapi.json containing the "openapi" key. Vercel's llms.txt links the REST API OpenAPI description and tells agents to read it before calling the REST API. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the spec's coverage and versioning against the REST API.
